ACO REACH PY2024                   Financial and Quality Results Data Dictionary
           Variable Name                               Term Name                                         Definition
ACO_ID                                    ACO ID                                    ACO Identifier Number
ACO_NAME                                  ACO Name                                  ACO Name
ACO_TYPE                                  ACO Type                                  Classification of ACO as Standard, New
                                                                                    Entrant, or High Needs
FIRST_PART_YEAR                           First Participation Year                  First year of participation in the model
PERF_YEAR                                 Performance Year                          Year in which the ACO participated
RISK_ARRANGEMENT                          Risk Arrangement                          ACO election of either Global or Professional
                                                                                    risk
STOP_LOSS_ELECTION                        Stop Loss Election                        ACO Participated in Stop-Loss Arrangement
CAPITATION_ARRANGEMENT                    Capitation Arrangement                    Capitation Arrangement Elected by the ACO
ENHANCED_PCC_ELECTION                     Enhanced PCC Election                     ACO Elected to Participate in Enhanced
                                                                                    Primary Care Capitation
APO_ELECTION                              APO Election                              ACO Elected to Participate in Advanced
                                                                                    Payment Option
ALIGNMENT_PLUS                            Alignment Plus                            ACO Elected to Participate in Alignment Plus
DISCOUNT                                  Discount                                  Discount based on risk arrangement
RETENTION_WITHHOLD                        Retention Withhold                        Retention Withhold
UNADJ_BENCHMARK                           Unadjusted Benchmark                      Benchmark before Adjustments, Withhold,
                                                                                    Discounts, and Retrospective Trend
                                                                                    Adjustment
FINAL_BENCHMARK                           Final Benchmark                           Final Benchmark before Population
                                                                                    Adjustment (PA)
NORM_RISK_SCORE                           Normalized weighted average risk          Normalized weighted average risk score
                                          score
CIF_CAP_RISK                              Normalized weighted average risk          Normalized weighted average risk score,
                                          score, adjusted for CIF and Risk          adjusted for CIF and Risk Score Cap
                                          Score Cap
PA_UP_AMT                                 Total amount of upwards                   Total amount of upwards Population
                                          adjustment PA dollars                     Adjustment (PA) dollars
PA_DOWN_AMT                               Total amount of downwards                 Total amount of downwards Population
                                          adjustment PA dollars                     Adjustment (PA) dollars
PA_UP_MNTHS                               Total months receiving an                 Total months receiving an upwards
                                          upwards PA adjustment                     Population Adjustment (PA)
PA_DOWN_MNTHS                             Total months receiving a                  Total months receiving a downwards
                                          downwards PA adjustment                   Population Adjustment (PA)
SAV_RATE                                  Savings Rate                              Gross Savings divided by Final Benchmark
TRENDED_AD_BASELINE                       Trended Aged/Disabled Baseline            3-year average benchmark historical rate for
                                                                                    the Aged/Disabled Benchmark
